title: Too specific
text:
I got the largest box and was SO disappointed when every item included was for “acne prone” skin, and for clearing up acne blemishes. That’s not at all my skin type and I just wish there had been some variety so that at least one thing in the box would have been useful.
Also the directions on how to use each product were vague and hard to find. An insert like Ipsy does would have been great.
label: negative
